stories.title: Path 2: Downside Friction — Persistent User Attrition & Category Monetization Cap
stories.short_summary: Tinder payer decay (-3.5% to -5.0% annually) and lower-ARPU international Hinge expansion contract consolidated revenues from $3.48B to $3.15B while operating margins compress to 20.5%. Stock-based compensation ($240M/yr) and maintenance CapEx ($20M/yr) reduce Owner Earnings from $820M to $530M, partially offset by modest share repurchases.
